name: Call Audio Bridge
description: Bidirectional PCM call audio, explicitly started for one active PSTN call.

settings.label: Requested sample rate
settings.help: Telephony normally uses 16 kHz; the bridge asks for this rate and uses the rate the returned Android audio endpoints report.

settings.label: Permit call audio bridging
settings.help: Call audio is sensitive, so every unit starts disabled and must be enabled deliberately.
